info.title: Vacademy Catalogue API
info.description: Read an institute's published courses, streams and learning paths for its own website, and send enquiries into its CRM.

get.description:
The institute, where its course pages live, and the languages, formats, currency and price visibility of its catalogue. `catalog` mirrors the hosted site's Courses-section settings: default sort and sort menu, quick filters, price / language / category filter panels, badge rules, custom filter groups and the hero's popular searches. Use it to build filters.

Scope: `catalog:read`. Cacheable for 60 s.

discovery_on.summary: Badges, quick filters, price filter and a custom group on

get.description:
The institute's published courses, one entry per course (language versions and levels are `variants`), filtered the way the hosted catalogue's Courses page filters them.

Comma lists: the values of one parameter are OR-ed, different parameters are AND-ed. A single value behaves as before. Version-level filters (`language`, `price`, `price_min`, `price_max`, `level`, `session`, `tag`, `instructor`) must all hold on the SAME version of a course: `language=hi&price=paid` means a paid Hindi version. Unknown stream or category slugs, format keys, language codes and custom groups or options match nothing (an empty page, not an error).

With `facets=true` the response adds `facets`: live counts per filter option, each group counted against every other active filter.

Scope: `catalog:read`. Cacheable for 60 s.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words, in any order, case-insensitive: the whole text as a substring of any version's title, plain-text description, an instructor's name or a course tag, or every word among those (3+ letter words also match a word's start). Month names = their short forms, 2024 = '24, singular = plural; filler such as pdf, ebook, course, notes is not required.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream slugs from `GET /streams`, comma-separated (any of them). An unknown slug matches nothing.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slugs from `GET /streams`, comma-separated (any of them); looked up in the given `stream`s, else in every stream. An unknown slug matches nothing.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format keys from `GET /site`, comma-separated (any of them). An unknown key matches nothing.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language codes from `GET /site` `languages`, comma-separated (any of them). Keeps courses with a version in that language; a single code also shows that version. An unknown code matches nothing. Ignored when the site has course languages off.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: One or more tags, comma-separated; a course matches if a version has any of them (case-insensitive, whole tag).

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Level names, comma-separated (any of them), case-insensitive. Book-store convention: `Buy` / `Rent` also match a version whose package type or any field equals it.

parameters.name: instructor
parameters.description: Instructor names, comma-separated (any of them), case-insensitive: a version's first instructor, as in the hosted site's Instructor filter.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Session ids (`variants[].session_id`), comma-separated (any of them).

parameters.name: badge
parameters.description: Badges, comma-separated (any of them): `bestseller`, `popular`, `new`, `free`. Matches every badge a course earned (`badges`), whatever the site displays. Anything else is `400`.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: `free` (a version priced 0) or `paid` (a version priced above 0). Coming-soon versions never match. When the site hides prices, it still filters on the real prices; amounts stay hidden.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on a version's price (major units). Coming-soon versions never match.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on a version's price (major units); `catalog.price_filter.max_options` are the site's steps. Coming-soon versions never match.

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: Options of the site's own filter groups (`GET /site` `catalog.custom_filters`): `<group id>:<option id>`, comma-separated. OR within a group, AND across groups; an option matches when any version carries one of its tags or level names. An unknown group or option selects nothing. A token without a colon is `400`.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Availability of the version shown.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Courses per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `newest` (by `created_at`, default), `oldest`, `price_asc`, `price_desc` (by the lowest price on sale now among the matching versions), `rating` (highest first; unrated last), `title` (A–Z), `title_desc` (Z–A), `popular` (by `popularity_rank`; unranked courses after the ranked ones, in catalogue order), `relevance` (with `q`: the closest titles first, then newest; without `q`, as `newest`). Ties keep catalogue order. Any other value is `400 invalid_request`.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: `true` (or `1`) adds `facets` to the response. Default `false` (or `0`); anything else is `400`.

post.description:
Saves an enquiry into the institute's CRM, exactly like the hosted catalogue's enquiry form. Call it from your server and pass the visitor's IP in `X-Client-IP`.

Scope: `leads:write`. Limits: 30 per minute per key, and 5 per minute per visitor IP. Never cached.

parameters.name: X-Client-IP
parameters.description: The visitor's IP, for the per-visitor limit. Server-side calls only; ignored on browser calls (the network address is used).

example.message: Is the Hindi edition available as a printed book?

200.description: Duplicate: already in this campaign. Nothing new was saved.

400.description: The body is not valid. `details.param` names the field.

error.message: email is not a valid email address.
course_id is not a published course of this institute.

Bearer.description: The same key as `Authorization: Bearer vak_pub_…`.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request. Quote it to support.

CacheControl.description: `public, max-age=60` on reads; `no-store` on errors and `POST /leads`.

BadRequest.description: A query parameter or the body is not valid.

Unauthorized.description: No key, or the key is not valid.

error.message: Send your publishable key in the X-API-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer).
This API key is invalid, revoked or expired.

Forbidden.description: The key may not make this request, or the browser origin is not one of the institute's verified websites.

error.message: Add and verify preview-abc.vercel.app in Settings → Integrations → Catalogue API & websites to call this API from it.
This API key does not have the leads:write scope.

NotFound.description: No such course or learning path for this institute.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key (or, on `POST /leads`, this visitor).

error.message: Too many requests for this API key (limit 1200 per minute).

AuthUnavailable.description: Keys could not be checked for a moment. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

error.message: Could not verify the API key right now. Retry shortly.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: A sentence for logs. Wording may change.

request_id.description: Also in the `X-Request-Id` header. Quote it to support.

details.description: Present only when there is more to say: `param` (invalid_request), `required_scope` (insufficient_scope), `origin` (origin_not_allowed), `limit_per_minute` (rate_limited).

code.description: Lower-case language code from the site's settings, e.g. `en`, `hi`.

chip.description: Short text the hosted site prints on course cards, e.g. `EN`, `हिं`. Falls back to `label`.

key.description: Lower-case format key, e.g. `ebook`. Use it in `GET /courses?format=`.

label.description: The name the hosted catalogue shows on course cards (the site's label mode: title or subtitle).

Place.description: A stream or category a course belongs to.

amount.description: Price in major units (rupees for INR), e.g. `251.0`. `0` when free.

compare_at_amount.description: The higher list price to show struck through, or null.

amount.description: Price in major units (rupees for INR), e.g. `251.0`. `0` when free.

compare_at_amount.description: The higher list price to show struck through, or null.

varies.description: True when the versions on sale now have different prices (show "from" `min_amount`).

min_amount.description: Lowest price among the versions on sale now that match the filters: the "from ₹X" amount. Equals `amount` when there is one price. Never reveals a hidden paid price.

max_amount.description: Highest price among the versions on sale now that match the filters. Equals `amount` when there is one price.

Price.description: Price of the version the course is shown as.

package_session_id.description: Id of this version (one level / batch of the course).

enroll_invite_id.description: Enrolment invite the hosted page uses for this version.

title.description: This version's title (a language edition has its own).

level.description: Level name, or null for a course without named levels.

session_id.description: The session (batch) this version belongs to. Use it in `GET /courses?session=`.

language.description: This version's language, or null (languages off, or none detected).

url.description: This version's page on the hosted catalogue site. Null when the course page address is not configured.

availability.description: `available`: can be bought or enrolled now. `coming_soon`: announced, not on sale. `not_started`: enrolment opens later. `closed`: enrolment ended or inactive.

price.description: Null unless the version is free, or priced and prices are shown.

Variant.description: One version of a course: a level, batch or language edition.

id.description: The course id. Stable across language versions. Use it in `GET /courses/{id}`.

subtitle.description: Plain text, at most 300 characters: the card text.

image_url.description: Card image (absolute URL): the first of `images.preview_url`, `banner_url`, `thumbnail_url`.

url.description: The course's page on the hosted catalogue site, where enrolment, cart and checkout happen. Includes the version's query string. Null when the course page address is not configured.

languages.description: Languages the course is available in. Empty when the site has course languages off.

level.description: Level of the version shown; null for a course without named levels.

availability.description: `available`: can be bought or enrolled now. `coming_soon`: announced, not on sale. `not_started`: enrolment opens later. `closed`: enrolment ended or inactive.

price_visible.description: False when the institute hides prices and this course is paid. Show "see price" and link to `url`.

price.description: Null when the course is not on sale now (see `availability`) or its price is hidden.

rating.description: Average rating, or null when there is none.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. The newest version's creation time; `sort=newest` uses it.

badges.description: Every badge the course earned, in priority order (the site's `catalog.badges.types` first, then the rest). The hosted site shows only types in `catalog.badges.types`, at most `catalog.badges.max`, and only when `catalog.badges.enabled`.

popularity_rank.description: 1 = most learners enrolled (active enrolments, institute-wide). Null when nobody is enrolled or ranks are unavailable. A course folding several language packages takes its best rank. Refreshed every 10 minutes.

duration_minutes.description: The course's read time in minutes; null when not set.

available_slots.description: Seats available, as set by the institute; null when not set.

max_seats.description: Seat limit; null when not set.

package_type.description: The course's package type as authored (e.g. `Buy`, `Rent`), or null.

coming_soon.description: Set for a course announced as Coming Soon; null otherwise.

id.description: YouTube or Vimeo video id (kind youtube / vimeo only).

url.description: Direct video file URL (kind url only).

embed_url.description: iframe-ready player URL for youtube / vimeo; null for url.

Series.description: The learning path this course is a step of.

canonical_url.description: The hosted course page without its query string.

description_html.description: Sanitised HTML (jsoup relaxed safelist; images http(s) only).

series.description: Null unless a learning path of 2+ steps lists this course.

structured_data.description: A schema.org `Course` (JSON-LD) object, ready for `<script type="application/ld+json">`.

CourseList.description: A page of courses. `facets` is present only with `facets=true`.

course_base_url.description: Where course pages live on the hosted site, e.g. `https://learning.brahmvarchas.org/store`.

languages.description: Course languages; empty when the site has them off.

formats.description: Every format the site defines, in display order.

currency.description: The most common currency across courses.

price_visible.description: False when the institute hides prices on its catalogue.

levels.description: One entry per version (all versions, or those in `language`).

notify_campaign_id.description: CRM campaign for "notify me" sign-ups (`POST /leads` `campaign_id`); null unless the folder has a notify audience.

course_count.description: Courses tagged into this stream or any of its categories.

tag.description: The course tag the stream filters by, e.g. `dharma`.

notify_campaign_id.description: CRM campaign for "notify me" sign-ups (`POST /leads` `campaign_id`); null unless the folder has a notify audience.

source.description: Where the site's streams come from; null when streams are off.

stream_slug.description: The top-level folder (stream) the path sits in.

url.description: Hosted course page (with the version query string).

lastmod.description: ISO-8601 UTC; the newest version's creation time.

email.description: A valid email address, at most 254 characters.

phone.description: Digits with optional `+`, spaces, `()`, `-`, `.`; 6-24 characters, at least 6 digits. E.g. `+91 98765 43210`.

course_id.description: A course id from this API. Must be a published course of the institute.

campaign_id.description: CRM campaign to file the enquiry under. An unknown or inactive id silently falls back to the default "Course Catalogue Leads" list.

source.description: Where on your site the form is, e.g. `homepage-hero`. At most 100 characters.

custom_fields.description: Up to 30 extra fields. Keys: 1-64 letters, digits, spaces, `_`, `-`, `.`. Values: text, number or boolean, at most 1,000 characters. Reserved keys (any case, 400 if used): `full_name`, `fullname`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `mobile`, `mobile_number`, `message`, `source`, `course_id`.

status.description: `received`: a new enquiry was saved (HTTP 201). `duplicate`: this person already enquired in this campaign, or the institute's duplicate rules matched (HTTP 200). Treat both as success.

Sort.description: `newest` / `oldest` (by `created_at`), `price_asc` / `price_desc` (by the lowest price on sale now among the matching versions), `rating` (highest first, unrated last), `title` / `title_desc` (A–Z / Z–A), `popular` (by `popularity_rank`, unranked courses after the ranked ones in catalogue order).

Badge.description: `bestseller`: among the top `bestseller_top` (default 3) paid courses by enrolment rank. `popular`: the best-ranked course of its stream. `new`: created within `new_days` (default 60) days. `free`: its cheapest version on sale now costs 0.

CourseImages.description: The course's images; each null when not set.

button_text.description: The hosted site's button text, e.g. "Notify me".

ribbon_text.description: The ribbon text on the card.

notify_campaign_id.description: The CRM campaign to send "notify me" sign-ups to: `POST /leads` with this `campaign_id`.

ComingSoon.description: Coming Soon settings of a course announced but not on sale yet.

slug.description: Stream or category slug: apply with `stream` / `category`.

count.description: Courses that would match with this option as the group's only choice, given every other active filter.

key.description: The value to pass to the matching parameter (`format`, `level`, `instructor`, `tag` (lower-case), `badge`).

under.description: One entry per `catalog.price_filter.max_options` step; apply with `price_max`.

Facets.description: Live counts per filter option over the whole result set (not just the page). Each group is counted against every OTHER active filter, so its counts do not collapse to its own selection. Only options with a count above 0 are listed, except `custom` groups whose `show_empty` is true.

categories.description: Categories of the selected streams, or of all streams.

tags.description: `key` is lower-case; `label` is the tag as authored.

custom.description: `{<group id>: {<option id>: count}}` for the site's `catalog.custom_filters`. Apply with `custom=<group id>:<option id>`.

value.description: The language code (`language`) or amount (`price_max`); null otherwise.

params.description: The `GET /courses` parameters that apply it, e.g. `{"sort": "popular"}`, `{"badge": "new"}`, `{"badge": "bestseller"}`, `{"price": "free"}`, `{"language": "hi"}`, `{"price_max": 250.0}`.

source.description: `course_formats` when the options are the site's formats; null for authored options.

show_empty.description: True: options with no courses stay listed (with 0 in `facets.custom`).

visible_count.description: Options shown before a "show all" link; null = all.

PopularSearch.description: A "Popular:" chip of the search hero. `search` → `q`; `stream` → `stream` (and `category`); `quick_filter` → the quick filter with that id; `route` → a link to that path. Unused keys are null.

Catalog.description: The hosted site's Courses-section settings, so a client can offer the same sort menu, quick filters, filter panels, badges and search chips.

default_sort.description: The site's default sort. `GET /courses` itself still defaults to `newest`.

sort_options.description: The sorts the hosted site's menu offers.

show_filter_counts.description: Whether the site prints facet counts beside options.

label.description: The panel's heading, or null for the site's default.

scope.description: `stream`: categories of the selected stream only.

show_all_label.description: Label of the "show all" link; `{count}` is the total.

types.description: Badge types the site shows, in priority order.

max.description: At most this many pills per card.
